ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the location map on the left of Figure A marks an inland lake near about 40°N, 60°E, and "desert" is marked around the lake, indicating that the lake is located in an arid inland region; Figure B is a partial enlarged map of the lake, using different line types to show the lake shorelines or seasonal water-level changes in April, July, and November. Then reason: a famous inland lake near 40°N, 60°E and located in a desert matches the characteristics of the Aral Sea. The prominent environmental problems in the Aral Sea region usually include lake shrinkage, reduction of water volume, land desertification, soil salinization, ecological deterioration, etc.; while acid rain is mainly related to sulfur oxides and nitrogen oxides from industrial emissions and relatively abundant precipitation, and is not a prominent environmental problem of this arid inland lake region. Therefore, the prominent environmental problem that cannot occur in this region is acid rain.
